verdict.rationale: Kit's broadcast API covers the whole loop. It creates broadcasts with subject, HTML content and preview text. It targets all subscribers or a subset by segment or tag IDs. It drafts or schedules sends via `send_at`, and the API overview says you can "create and send broadcasts." Kit's in-app email editor is mentioned, and the pricing page lists unlimited broadcasts. All of this is vendor documentation only. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detailed documentation of the in-app campaign composer UI and of the immediate-send path (as distinct from scheduling)

support.subject: As a marketer, I can compose an email campaign, pick its audience, and send or schedule it — the arena's table-stakes loop

citations.quote: Draft or schedule to send a broadcast to all or a subset of your subscribers... We currently support targeting your subscribers based on segment or tag ids.
Returns a single broadcast's full record: subject, `content` (HTML), preview text, targeting (`subscriber_filter`), email template, sending schedule (`send_at`)
you will be able to create and send broadcasts to your subscribers
